description: One streamed OpenAI chat answer with usage, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default: TraceConfig hide_inputs and hide_outputs are false, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The client sets stream_options.include_usage. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the answer into 4 chunks. The span has one event, First Token Stream Event, with no attributes; there is no timing attribute. Prompt and completion counts are copied. Zero audio, reasoning, and cache_read detail counts are written. llm.finish_reason is span-level only. Covers D113 (event-based TTFT).
